title: Work 4
note: B2 leaf to the Travel 3 template, 2026-09-05. Work 1-3 own the basics through promotion/overtime/deadline (B1 recap card names them); this is hiring, pay and leaving. Family card: recruit/apply/resign/retire/dismiss -> recruitment/applicant/resignation/retirement/dismissal, all drilled. Pool-checked; salary/strike/colleague/contract were already taught and are excluded.

cards.title: You already know
cards.note: Work 3 was the working week: employment, vacancy, hire, full-time, supervisor, income, pension, shift, workload, resign, retire. Those words carry this unit's sentences. The new ground is how you get a job, what you get paid, and how it ends.
cards.note_cz: Work 3 byl pracovní týden: employment, vacancy, hire, full-time, supervisor, income, pension, shift, workload, resign, retire. Ta slova nesou zdejší věty. Nové je, jak práci získáš, co za ni dostaneš a jak končí.

cards.title: Build the family
points: Verbs you know become this unit's nouns and people.
**-ment**, **-ant**, **-ation** and **-al** do the building — five of the 36 words.
